paragraphs: Chilfa in the Jerusalem Talmud's language is Ilfa in the Babylonian Talmud. So the commentator on the Jerusalem Talmud writes at the end of chapter 6 of Ketubot and in Kiddushin, chapter 1, halakhah 1. Nevertheless, I have written each in his own place.
